newsitem.title: FINLAND: COOP BANKING CENTRE BECOMES OKOBANK PARENT.
newsitem.headline: COOP BANKING CENTRE BECOMES OKOBANK PARENT.

text.p: The Finnish cooperative banking centre (OPK) said in a statement on Wednesday it had become parent company to OKOBANK, holding 53.3 percent of votes.
"The OPK cooperative became OKOBANK's parent company on June 18, 1997 when it bought OKO K shares from cooperative banks which raise OPK's stake to 53.3 percent of OKO votes," it said.

The deal was part of the cooperative banking group's earlier announced restructuring and would have no material impact on other OKOBANK shareholders' position, on OKOBANK's position or on OKOBANK's earnings outlook for the rest of the year, it said.
